title: SoulChain
description: SoulLinkCurse automatically links two players’ souls so damage and death affect both, and the curse can only be broken by performing a ritual with specific items inside a secret chest hidden in a desert temple.
body: SoulLinkCurse is a Bukkit plugin for Minecraft 1.21.4 that automatically links two players’ souls, causing damage and death to affect both simultaneously. The powerful curse persists until broken by a special ritual performed inside a secret chest hidden within a desert temple. Players must place specific rare items to complete the ritual and break the curse. If either linked player leaves the game, the other is forcibly disconnected to maintain the bond’s integrity. Perfect for adding tension, teamwork, and mystery to your server gameplay!
